prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Control & Desktop Interaction Guide Screen: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right after home intro showing step-by-step instructions on how to summon, hide, and talk to the pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple emails after onboarding from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Before Final Home Intro: Reorder sign-in to appear after generation finishes and right before home intro so users experience pet creation before account setup. (why: Sign-in dropoff is 24.6% and 8 users reported missing pets after signing in with wrong accounts; placing sign-in after pet creation ties account creation directly to saving the custom pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Health Diagnostic Indicator: Show a real-time desktop window system check progress bar on the waiting screen to verify screen permissions. (why: Support received tickets about pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch post-generation.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Quick Story Setup Expectation Banner: Update story screen headline and body copy to set clear expectations that setup takes under 60 seconds. (why: Initial story/choose_path phase exhibits extreme mean duration (514s), suggesting users delay starting.)

scores.note: Addresses 35.2% finish dropoff supported by user emails, but requires a brand new screen.

Adds diagnostic info for home step issues backed by support tickets; moderate effort.
